newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 23 die in Colombia bloodshed.
newsitem.headline: At least 23 die in Colombia bloodshed.

text.p: At least 23 people, nine of them civilians, died in a wave of attacks by leftist guerrillas across Colombia over the weekend and early Monday, military sources said.

Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels attacked a police post in Caldono, in southwest Cauca province, early Monday killing two policemen, an 80-year-old woman and a 15-year- old girl. A guerrilla also died in the attack.
Three soldiers died and 25 others were wounded when they wandered into a minefield laid by Marxist revolutionaries in the jungles of southern Caqueta province on Sunday, an army spokesman said.
In northern Magdalena province, five peasants were killed Sunday in an attack which the security forces blamed on guerrillas.
Six rebels died in the conflict-torn banana-growing region of Uraba in weekend clashes between the army and the FARC, Colombia's oldest and largest guerrilla group.
Three civilians, including a town mayor and a local politician, and another leftist rebel died in other incidents.
